nodes.description: Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the implementation address (EIP-1967 slot).
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the admin address (EIP-1967 admin slot).
Initializes implementation and admin slots; stores msg.sender as admin.
Admin-gated function that writes a new implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Admin-gated function that writes a new admin address into ADMIN_SLOT.
View function returning the implementation address stored in IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Internal helper that reads a slot and casts it to address.
Internal view helper performing assembly sload on a given slot.
Internal helper performing assembly sstore into a given slot.
Internal function that delegatecalls the implementation with full msg.data.
Payable receive function accepting plain ETH transfers without logic.
Payable fallback that reads the implementation slot and delegates the call.
Caller-controlled address used for admin checks and constructor admin assignment.
Assembly delegatecall executing untrusted implementation code in proxy storage context.
Assembly sstore writing raw slot values (implementation/admin) into storage.
Constructor parameter: initial implementation address.
setImplementation parameter: new implementation address.
setAdmin parameter: new admin address.
_getAddress parameter: slot key to read.
_getSlotValue parameter: slot to load.
_setSlotValue parameter: slot to store into.
_setSlotValue parameter: value to store.
_delegate parameter: target address for delegatecall.
Return local holding the implementation address in implementation().
Return local holding the address in _getAddress().
Return local holding the loaded bytes32 in _getSlotValue().
Assembly local holding delegatecall success flag.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the initial admin in the constructor.
setImplementation requires msg.sender to equal the stored admin.
setAdmin requires msg.sender to equal the stored admin.
Caller identity gates the storage write performed through _setSlotValue.
Constructor parameter impl flows into the implementation slot write.
newImpl flows into the implementation slot write.
newAdmin flows into the admin slot write.
Constructor calls _setSlotValue to persist implementation and admin.
setImplementation calls _setSlotValue to write the implementation slot.
setAdmin calls _setSlotValue to write the admin slot.
setImplementation reads the admin address via _getAddress for its authorization check.
setAdmin reads the admin address via _getAddress for its authorization check.
_getAddress loads the raw slot value through _getSlotValue.
_setSlotValue performs an assembly sstore writing arbitrary slot/value pairs.
Constructor writes the implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Constructor writes the admin address into ADMIN_SLOT.
setImplementation modifies IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
setAdmin modifies ADMIN_SLOT.
fallback reads IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT to resolve the delegate target.
implementation() reads the value stored in IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
fallback resolves the implementation address by calling _getAddress.
fallback forwards the call to _delegate, which executes untrusted implementation code.
_delegate performs a delegatecall to the implementation address.
The delegatecalled implementation can re-enter the proxy fallback with attacker-controlled calldata.
implementation__ parameter is used as the delegatecall target.
implementation__ flows directly into the delegatecall operation.
implementation() obtains its value via _getSlotValue.
impl local receives the value returned by implementation().
key parameter selects the slot read by _getAddress.
add local receives the address returned by _getAddress.
slot_get parameter selects the slot loaded by _getSlotValue.
value_local receives the slot value loaded by _getSlotValue.
slot_set parameter is the storage slot written by _setSlotValue.
value_set parameter is the value written by _setSlotValue.
result local captures the delegatecall success flag in _delegate.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter impl is only used inside the constructor's slot writes, so it normalizes into the constructor.
newImpl is consumed solely by setImplementation's storage write and normalizes into that function.
newAdmin is consumed solely by setAdmin's storage write and normalizes into that function.
key is the slot selector of _getAddress and collapses into that helper.
slot_get is the slot selector of _getSlotValue and collapses into that helper.
slot_set is the target slot of the assembly sstore in _setSlotValue.
value_set is the value written by the assembly sstore in _setSlotValue.
implementation__ is the direct target of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
impl is the return local of implementation() and merges into it.
add is the return local of _getAddress and merges into it.
value_local is the return local of _getSlotValue and merges into it.
result is the assembly local capturing the delegatecall outcome inside _delegate.
